lowIncomeTaxReduction.note: Not modeled for v1; death-year returns with deemed dispositions exceed the reduction income threshold in effectively all modeled cases. Source data captured in Ontario MOF 2026 dataset for later.

principalResidence.formula: Per ITA 40(2)(b), remaining gain after exemption = A - (A * B / C) - D, so exempt portion = A * B / C; B = 1 + designated years (capped at C; post-1981 one designation per family unit per s. 54); C = years owned since acquisition date; D applies only to pre-1994 s. 110.6(19) elections
